correctness.rationale: The generator D^{-1}A−I has eigenvalues 0,−1 (within-class mean-zero),−2 (interclass mean difference). For a=e^(−t), the cut output has four class-value combinations; summing within and cross pairs exactly produces a[1+(1−a)C_{p,q}(r,s)]. Finite layer-cake/coarea over all pair differences reduces the operator norm to binary cuts with equality at a maximizing cut. For d=r/p−s/q>0 the numerator equals (qr−ps)[1−2(r/p)(1−s/q)], strictly below G(1_S) if positive; symmetry covers negative d. Hence C<1 for every finite pair. Singleton cut r=1,s=0 with p=k,q=k² gives C=k(k−2)/(k²+k−1)→1, proving the exact unattained envelope a(2−a). Independently checked direct normalized semigroup matrix exponentials and all binary cuts for K1,1, K2,3, K3,5, K5,2 at t=.87. This does not assert a closed analytic optimizer over r,s.
